note: v2149: #163. v2135 shipped the settled-card fold in five files with zero tests, and the defect it predicted was already live: push() takes needsHim as an explicit sixth argument so the renderer never greps its own prose, and the cost of that choice is that omitting it renders the card LOUD. Rank 4.5 contestedExpired omitted it while its own next-action sentence says the rows are not contradictions and are not listed above, the same nothing-to-do shape as rank 3.5 which passes false. So a card saying nothing needs him sat permanently expanded. Fixed, and the whole fold map is now pinned by a spec that EXECUTES the shipped renderer against the shipped stylesheet rather than reading the source, because two different source parsers each gave a wrong answer, the second by splitting the call on commas inside a comment.
